alignments.note: διὰ τοῦτο -> *For this cause*: the ASV spreads the phrase over words answering to each token, so rule 45's closing clause gives *For ... cause* to the preposition headed on *For* and leaves *this* to the demonstrative. Rule 46's head on *cause* is confined to the postposition χάριν, where no Greek preposition is expressed.

ἀναμιμνῄσκω rendered by the support frame *put ... in remembrance of*; rule 91 heads on the word carrying the lexeme's sense. The frame's own prepositions are licensed by the supplied *remembrance* and stay inside the unit: rule 21 keeps such a preposition with the frame and gives the governed word a bare noun, and rule 106's accusative arm says the same from the other side, τὰς ὁδούς being accusative and having no case for an English preposition to realize. This is rule 21's οὐ λογίζεται τὸ κακόν -> *taketh not account of evil*, and 1CO.4.1 reads the identical frame the same way. Discontinuous around the object under rule 15.
Accusative object standing bare; an accusative has no case for an English preposition to realize (rule 106).
The determiner slot before *ways* is occupied by the possessive *my*, which belongs to the genitive pronoun s020, so the article realizes nothing (rule 20).
Genitive pronoun rendered by the possessive, which the ASV places before the noun.

Accusative object standing bare, exactly as ὑμᾶς does at s016 in the same clause: the *of* in front of it is the support frame's own, licensed by the supplied *remembrance*, and stays with ἀναμνήσει under rules 21 and 106. The article having been emptied by the possessive (rule 20), nothing else stands here to carry a determiner or a preposition.

No answering καί stands in the construction, so the comparative keeps *even as* whole under rule 82's closing clause, headed on *as*.

review_notes: All 29 source and 40 target ids are partitioned exactly once.
SBLGNT.1CO.4.17.v009 selected r01 and covers no source token, so it has no bearing on the alignment.
διὰ τοῦτο is headed on *For* under rule 45 rather than on *cause*, which rule 46 reserves for χάριν.
The frame preposition *of* is kept with ἀναμνήσει under rules 21 and 106; giving it to ὁδούς would contradict s016 in the same clause and 1CO.4.1 in the same chapter.
